persons.name: Jayaraṇajitamalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrījayaraṇajita malladevamahārājādhirāja viracite ... śrīśrījayaraṇajita malladevasana kārttika vrata saṃpūrṇṇa yāṅāva thva pyākhana huyakā

purpose: kārttika vrata saṃpūrṇṇa yāṅāva thva pyākhana huyakā (performed/staged on the completion of the Kārttika vrata)
notes: The colophon records the staging/sponsoring of the play (thva pyākhana huyakā) by King Raṇajit Malla of Bhaktapur upon completing his Kārttika vrata. The manuscript itself does not explicitly record a scribe.
